text:
Before: a wrap cut in half (a veggie wrap with cheese, avocado, cucumber, and sprouts), plus 2 sushi pieces (salmon and cucumber/avocado), and soy sauce.

After: the wrap and sushi are gone. A slice of cheese is left on the plate, and some soy sauce remains in the cup.

Estimated wrap: about 220 g in total, around 400 kcal. The leftover cheese slice is about 20 g, roughly 70 kcal, and it looks like it was removed from the wrap. So the wrap eaten is about 330 kcal and 200 g.

Sushi: 2 pieces at about 35 g each is 70 g, roughly 90 kcal. Some soy sauce was used, about 5 g and 5 kcal.

Total: about 425 kcal and about 275 g.
